character: 45 km purpose-built resort at 2,000 m. Good snow record for the southern Alps.
name: Isola 2000
description: 120km of pistes, 28 lifts, in the Alpes-Maritimes, 90 minutes from Nice. Purpose-built resort created by British ex-officer Peter Boumphrey (opened 1971). The closest high-altitude resort to the French Riviera. Known for: the widest easy cruisers in the Alps (21 blue runs), 75% snowmaking, night skiing twice weekly during French holidays, and the longest season in the Southern Alps. 36 mountain restaurants, snow park, via ferrata. Provencal food (tapenade, pissaladière, socca) in the mountains.

suitability.beginners: Excellent — 21 blue runs, widest cruisers in Alps
suitability.intermediates: Excellent — the domain is mostly blue
